correctness.rationale: The defining cosets have total size \(18\), giving dimension \(55\). The BCH bound gives \(d\ge5\); an exhaustive exact pair-signature certificate excludes weight \(5\), while explicit syndrome-zero supports of weight \(6\) exist. Equal-signature disjoint triple pairs are in bijection with weight-six supports counted once per unordered \(3+3\) partition, so \(8760/10=876\). Direct replay checks all supports and twelve size-73 cyclic orbits.

value.rationale: The recent paper singles out \(s=3\) as a genuine exceptional member and reports only its distance. The exact value \(A_6=876\) is the first nonzero weight-enumerator coefficient, a standard performance-relevant invariant for linear codes; the twelve-orbit decomposition adds compact structural information and a reusable certificate. This is a natural completion of the exceptional finite case rather than an arbitrary slice.
